title: Verbs of change: how the State changed

sections.content: You know *ponerse*, *volverse*, *hacerse* and *quedarse* from B1 Unit 25, and *convertirse en* + noun for bigger changes. Each one shows a different kind of change. Use them to say how the State changed in the early twentieth century.

items.spanish: El Estado se convirtió en un actor muy importante.
items.english: The State became a very important actor.

items.spanish: La burocracia se hizo más grande.
El Estado se volvió más cercano a la gente.
items.english: The State became closer to the people.

items.spanish: El Congreso se quedó cerrado hasta 1945.

sections.content: *Convertirse en* goes with a noun (*se convirtió en un actor*); *volverse* and *hacerse* with an adjective for a deeper or gradual change; *ponerse* and *quedarse* for a state that can pass or a result. Do not use *llegar a ser* here: you will meet it later.
